Marketplace price UNVALIDATED: no Flipkart/Amazon.in/Meesho 8-in kansa plate price found. If generic 'bronze' plates sell well below Rs 1,999 there, use the website channel only
'Pure kansa / bell metal / bronze' and any alloy ratio are material claims needing a supplier test report (require_evidence_for_claims); brass or plated look-alikes are common
Food-contact item: no health or Ayurvedic benefit claims in copy (regulated-claim risk); sell as tableware only
Bell metal can crack if dropped hard and dents in transit; needs rigid padded packing. Hand-beaten pieces vary by about 100 g, so state weight as a range
Tarnishes; include a care card (no dishwasher) to limit 'not as pictured' returns
Overlaps with the kansa katori lead (RA-20261120-1): the same supplier quote can cover both, and a plate + katori combo is a possible later bundle (check the 2 kg slab)
GST for bronze tableware (HSN 7418) to be confirmed by the CA; 12% kept for consistency with the katori file

2026-11-28 authenticity: guides on spotting fake or plated 'kansa' (https://kahpital.com/?p=6593, https://ora.it.com/kansa-purity-test/how-do-i-know-if-my-kansa-is-pure, https://samahomes.ca/blogs/sama-homes-insights/how-to-identify-pure-metals, https://dmimart.in/beware-of-brass-quality-scams/, seen via WebSearch snippets) describe brass passed off as bronze and plated pieces whose different base metal shows when the surface wears. They list home checks: a long bell-like ring for bronze against a dull thud for brass or plated pieces, a magnet check, weight, and a scratch test in a hidden spot. They agree that only a lab test (XRF) is conclusive. Ask the supplier for an XRF or alloy test report (Cu/Sn ratio) before any 'pure kansa' or '78:22' claim, and ring-test and weigh the first sample.

2026-11-28: Flipkart lists a 9-in bronze/kansa dinner plate (RBHMC) at Rs 1,674, below the proposed Rs 1,999 for a smaller 8-in plate. On Flipkart, Rs 1,999 may not hold without proof of Odisha hand-beaten origin and alloy, so lead with the website/D2C channel, where Rs 2,099-2,599 anchors exist.
